show.title: The Maid Who Owns the Mansion (sample)

timeline.text: INT. CROSS MANSION BALLROOM – NIGHT
A crystal chandelier glitters over a crowded engagement party.
AVA, in a grey maid's uniform, carries a tray of champagne through the guests.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Careful, maid. That dress costs more than your life.
Chloe deliberately bumps the tray. Glasses shatter across the marble floor.

timeline.speaker: VIVIAN
timeline.text: Clumsy girl! Clean it up. On your knees.
Guests laugh. Ava kneels slowly, picking up shards with bare hands.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Yes, Mrs. Cross.
Ethan watches from the staircase, jaw tight.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Mother, that's enough.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Darling, don't waste your pity on the help.
Chloe picks up a full glass of red wine and throws it in Ava's face.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Now you match the floor.
The room erupts in laughter. Wine drips from Ava's chin.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: You'll regret this, Miss Vance.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Regret? You're nothing. A nobody who scrubs our toilets.
INT. SERVANTS' QUARTERS – NIGHT
Ava washes the wine from her face in a cracked mirror.
Marcus, the old butler, slips in and closes the door behind him.

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: Miss Ava, you don't have to endure this. Not for one more day.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Not yet, Marcus. I need to see who they really are.

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: Your grandfather's will is read on Friday. After that, this house is yours.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Then let them enjoy it until Friday.
Footsteps outside. The door handle turns.
Ava and Marcus freeze.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Who's in there with you?
The door swings open. Ethan stands in the doorway.
SMASH CUT TO BLACK.
INT. SERVANTS' QUARTERS – CONTINUOUS
Ethan steps inside. Marcus quickly bows.

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: Young master. I was only bringing her a towel.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Leave us.
Marcus exits. Ethan studies Ava's stained uniform.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Why didn't you fight back?

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Because a maid who fights back loses her job.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: You don't talk like a maid.
He reaches out and wipes a drop of wine from her cheek. Ava steps back.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Goodnight, Mr. Cross.
INT. CROSS MANSION KITCHEN – MORNING
The staff prepare breakfast. Ava polishes silverware.
Chloe sweeps in wearing a silk robe.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: My engagement ring. It's gone. Someone in this kitchen took it.
The staff go silent.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Search her. The new girl. She was in Ethan's study last night.
A guard empties Ava's apron pocket. A diamond ring falls onto the counter.
Gasps around the kitchen.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: I've never seen that ring before.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Liar! Call the police.

timeline.speaker: VIVIAN
timeline.text: No police. Scandal is bad for the company. Just throw her out.
Two guards grab Ava by the arms and drag her toward the door.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Check the cameras! The study has cameras!
Chloe's smile flickers for half a second.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: The cameras were broken last week. What a shame.
EXT. CROSS MANSION GATE – DAY
Ava is shoved through the iron gate onto the wet pavement. Rain begins to fall.
A black Rolls-Royce pulls up beside her. The rear window rolls down.

timeline.speaker: MR. HALE
timeline.text: Miss Lockwood? Your grandfather's lawyer. We need to talk—now.
Ava looks back at the mansion. Her eyes harden.
INT. ROLLS-ROYCE – DAY

timeline.speaker: MR. HALE
timeline.text: Your grandfather owned sixty percent of Cross Holdings. Through you.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: So the Crosses have been living in my house.

timeline.speaker: MR. HALE
timeline.text: And spending your money. The will makes you chairwoman on Friday.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Don't tell anyone. Not yet.
INT. CROSS HOLDINGS LOBBY – DAY
Ava, still in her uniform, walks into the glass lobby.

timeline.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
timeline.text: Deliveries go around the back.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: I'm here to see the board.
The receptionist laughs and picks up the phone.

timeline.speaker: RECEPTIONIST
timeline.text: Security, we have a cleaner who thinks she's an executive.
Chloe steps out of the elevator with Vivian.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Oh, look. The thief came back for more.

timeline.speaker: VIVIAN
timeline.text: Get her out before the investors see her.
A guard grabs Ava's wrist. She doesn't move.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Take your hand off me. You'll want to keep this job after Friday.
The guard hesitates. Ethan walks in through the revolving door.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: What's going on here?

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: The maid stole my ring, and now she's stalking you.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Did you take it, Ava?

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Do you believe I did?
Ethan holds her gaze. Long silence.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: ...No. I don't.
Chloe's face goes pale.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Ethan, you're choosing a maid over your fiancée?

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: I'm choosing the truth. Pull the lobby cameras from last night.
Chloe grabs Vivian's arm and leans close.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: If he sees that footage, we're both finished.
Vivian looks at Ava as if seeing her for the first time.

timeline.speaker: VIVIAN
timeline.text: Who are you really?
INT. SECURITY ROOM – DAY
Ethan and a technician scroll through grainy footage.

timeline.speaker: TECHNICIAN
timeline.text: The study camera was switched off at nine. By an admin account.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Whose account?

timeline.speaker: TECHNICIAN
timeline.text: It's registered to... Miss Vance.
Ethan's hands curl into fists.
INT. CROSS MANSION – CHLOE'S BEDROOM – DAY
Chloe stuffs documents into a shredder.
Her phone buzzes. A message: "He knows."

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: No, no, no.
INT. CAFE – DAY
Ava sips coffee with Marcus. Quiet.

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: The lilies in the garden are blooming early this year.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Grandfather loved those lilies.

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: He'd be proud of you, Miss.
The cafe door opens. Ethan walks in, breathless.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: It was Chloe. She framed you. I'm so sorry.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Sorry doesn't give me back my name.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Then let me give you something else. Come to the gala tonight. As my guest.
Marcus raises an eyebrow.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: As your guest? Your fiancée will be there.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: She's not my fiancée anymore.
INT. CROSS MANSION BALLROOM – NIGHT
The gala. Ava enters in a stunning midnight-blue gown. The room turns.
Chloe, at the bar, slams down her glass.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: How dare you show your face here!
Chloe raises her hand and slaps Ava hard across the face.
The music stops.
Ava slowly turns her head back and slaps Chloe twice as hard.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: That's for the wine. The next one is for the ring.

timeline.speaker: VIVIAN
timeline.text: Security! Arrest this woman!
The ballroom doors burst open. Mr. Hale enters with two police officers.

timeline.speaker: MR. HALE
timeline.text: Nobody touches the chairwoman of Cross Holdings.
Every face in the ballroom turns to Ava.
INT. CROSS MANSION BALLROOM – CONTINUOUS

timeline.speaker: VIVIAN
timeline.text: Chairwoman? She's a maid!

timeline.speaker: MR. HALE
timeline.text: She is Ava Lockwood. Heir to Arthur Lockwood's sixty percent.
Gasps ripple through the guests.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: That's impossible. Lockwood's granddaughter died in the fire.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: I didn't die, Chloe. I was hidden. From people like you.
Ethan stares at Ava, stunned.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: You lied to me this whole time?

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: I watched. There's a difference.
EXT. CROSS MANSION GARDEN – NIGHT
Ethan finds Ava alone by the lily pond.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Everything my family has is yours. Why didn't you take it on day one?

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Because I wanted to know who would be kind to a maid.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: And?

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: You were. Only you.
Ethan steps closer. Their faces are inches apart.
Ethan kisses her.
INT. POLICE STATION – NIGHT
Chloe sits handcuffed. An officer slides a file across the table.

timeline.speaker: OFFICER
timeline.text: Fraud, theft, falsifying evidence. You're looking at five years.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Get me my phone. I get one call.
She dials. Someone answers.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: It's me. Plan B. Tonight.
INT. CROSS MANSION – AVA'S NEW SUITE – NIGHT
Ava unpins her hair, smiling for the first time.
A small envelope lies on her pillow. No name.
She opens the envelope. Inside, a photo of the burning Lockwood house.
Written on the back: "The fire was no accident."
Behind her, the balcony curtain moves.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Who's there?
INT. AVA'S SUITE – CONTINUOUS
A hooded figure lunges from the balcony and grabs Ava by the throat.
Ava screams. A lamp crashes to the floor.
Ethan bursts in and tackles the intruder.
The hood falls back. It's Marcus's nephew, DANNY.

timeline.speaker: DANNY
timeline.text: I'm sorry! She paid me! Chloe paid me!

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: To do what?

timeline.speaker: DANNY
timeline.text: To finish what her father started.
Ava goes pale.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Her father... set the fire?
INT. CROSS MANSION LIBRARY – LATER
Marcus pours tea with shaking hands.

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: Miss Ava, I should have told you years ago.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Told me what?

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: The night of the fire, Mr. Vance came to see your grandfather. They argued about the company.

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: An hour later, the east wing was burning.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: And you said nothing?

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: He threatened my family. I'm a coward, Miss.
Ava sets down her cup. Silence.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Thank you for telling me now.
INT. CROSS MANSION KITCHEN – MORNING
Vivian makes coffee herself for the first time. Awkward.

timeline.speaker: VIVIAN
timeline.text: Ava. I owe you an apology. For the knees. For everything.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Apology accepted, Mrs. Cross. Breakfast is still at eight.
Vivian laughs nervously.
INT. CROSS HOLDINGS BOARDROOM – DAY
Ava takes the head of the table. The board members stand.
The door opens. A silver-haired man walks in, smiling.

timeline.speaker: RICHARD VANCE
timeline.text: Congratulations, Miss Lockwood. I believe you have something of mine.
Chloe walks in behind him, free, wearing a visitor's badge.
INT. CROSS HOLDINGS BOARDROOM – CONTINUOUS

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Mr. Vance. The man who burned my family's house.

timeline.speaker: RICHARD VANCE
timeline.text: Careful. Slander is expensive.

timeline.speaker: RICHARD VANCE
timeline.text: I own thirty-five percent of this company. With Vivian's five, I'll own forty.

timeline.speaker: VIVIAN
timeline.text: I'm not giving you anything, Richard.

timeline.speaker: RICHARD VANCE
timeline.text: You will, when you see what I know about your husband's death.
Vivian goes white and sits down.
EXT. CROSS HOLDINGS ROOFTOP – DAY
Wind. Ava and Ethan at the railing.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: My father died in a car crash. That's what they told me.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Maybe that's what Vance wants you to believe.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Or maybe it's true and he's bluffing.
Ethan's phone buzzes. An unknown number.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Hello?

timeline.speaker: VOICE
timeline.text: Sign the shares over to Vance, or your mother learns the truth.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: What truth?

timeline.speaker: VOICE
timeline.text: That your father was alive when the car went into the river.
The call ends. Ethan stares at the phone.
INT. HOSPITAL EXAM ROOM – NIGHT
Chloe sits on an examination bed. A doctor checks a chart.

timeline.speaker: DOCTOR
timeline.text: Miss Vance, your results are back. You're eight weeks pregnant.
Chloe smiles slowly.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Perfect. Ethan can never leave me now.
Around the corner, Ava stands frozen, holding a bouquet of lilies.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Eight weeks...
INT. CROSS MANSION LIVING ROOM – DAY
Chloe drops an ultrasound photo on the coffee table in front of Ethan.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Congratulations, Daddy.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: That's not possible. We haven't been together in months.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: Count again, darling. Eight weeks. The night of your birthday.
Ethan turns to Ava. Ava looks away.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: I think I should go.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: Ava, wait—
EXT. LOCKWOOD FAMILY CEMETERY – DAY
Ava places lilies on her grandfather's grave.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: You built everything for me, Grandpa. And I still can't keep one person.
Footsteps behind her. Marcus.

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: Miss, there's something about that ultrasound. The clinic name.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: What about it?

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: It closed two years ago. Mr. Vance owned it.
Ava turns slowly.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Then the baby is a lie.

timeline.speaker: MARCUS
timeline.text: Or the baby is real... and the father isn't Ethan.
INT. CROSS MANSION NURSERY – NIGHT
Ethan stands among paint cans, staring at an empty crib.
Chloe enters holding a paternity test envelope.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: The DNA results. Open it. Prove you're the father.
Ethan tears the envelope. Ava appears in the doorway.

timeline.speaker: AVA
timeline.text: Before you read that, Ethan, ask her who paid for the test.
Chloe spins around.

timeline.speaker: CHLOE
timeline.text: You—
Ethan unfolds the paper. His eyes widen.

timeline.speaker: ETHAN
timeline.text: This says the father is—
SMASH CUT TO BLACK.

known_failure_modes.detail: If a key moment is only in the picture (a look, a reveal shot) and the screenplay line is bland, rules under-score it.
'Oh, how nice' scores as resolution; the cue lexicon reads words, not tone. The LLM pass fixes most of these.
Lines that reference earlier episodes ('like that night') are penalised even when the scene still lands for new viewers.
A question at the end looks like a cliffhanger even when it is rhetorical.
Montages are scored conservatively; editors' best multi-moment edits are the most likely misses.
When lines lack timestamps, IN/OUT points are interpolated from word counts and can drift by 1–2 s.
